competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, refer to a different product category, or describe a partial-refund or exchange window rather than the current full-refund standard-item window.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from delivery.
refutation_criterion: Current authoritative policy evidence shows the full-refund window for standard items is not 30 days, is not a full refund, or applies to a different item class.
